rust_summary: stack-dependent image tooltip components, measured with `native_tooltip_component` and rendered with `native_tooltip_component_draw`.
doc_summary: image tooltip components: `native_tooltip_component(stack, size)` answers finite positive width/height in GUI pixels, and `native_tooltip_component_draw(stack, batch, origin, size)` draws that component with `native_sprite`, `native_fill` and `native_text`. The stack supplies its data. Space and background are reserved after the text and any vanilla bundle component; the component width participates in tooltip positioning. Neither hook changes ordinary tooltips without an answer. Client-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:image_tooltips@.
